records.judge_reason: Shell completion and docs match the labels closely, and help output is largely preserved. Other themes are weaker. The first report theme is a huge catch-all of 26 issues. It merges parser issues, commands/context/subcommand issues, Click 9.0 release items, #531 (errors), #928 (dynamic choice) and #2992 (help info dict). Errors and exceptions has no theme of its own: those issues are folded into help/colour, which loosely holds together on the colour angle. Path and file types are mixed into terminal utilities. The typing/API/async theme mixes unrelated items such as #1997 (testing width) and #3036 (set types). Several themes match, but there is significant mixing and the dominant catch-all theme is incoherent.

records.judge_reason: Several themes line up well with the labelled ones. Help output matches almost exactly. Shell completion matches, apart from #1574 being pulled in. Prompts/terminal tools is a reasonable subset of the terminal utilities theme, and merging colour with exceptions is coherent. However, the parser theme is overloaded: it absorbs the Click 9.0 release issues (#3154, #3156) and several command/context issues (#1269, #1322, #473, #2753), which blurs a distinct topic. The commands/context/embedding theme is dissolved entirely, and the parameter types and files theme is missing. 'Typing, docs and project upkeep' is a grab-bag mixing internals, docs and a native types request (#3036). Many issues go unassigned (e.g. #2801, #2783, #2360, #2033, #680, #3888, #2645, #2429, #1428, #1378, #928, #2853, #531, #2706, #1997, #2992). Overall some themes match while others mix unrelated issues or are absent.

records.judge_reason: The report gets several labelled groupings right. File/LazyFile matches exactly, and Parser matches exactly. Context/invoke closely matches Commands/context, though it adds #2493 (generic Context, which is arguably coherent) and moves #2402 and #2361 elsewhere. Some placements are wrong. #2853 (stack trace on invalid parameter) is put in shell completion, and #2402 (resolve_command) is also misplaced there, which dilutes that theme. That merged theme also absorbs i18n (#2706) and embedding with custom stdout (#2361), which makes it a catch-all. The 9.0/opinions meta theme is dropped, and #2823 is missing entirely. Overall the report mostly tracks the labels, with a few misplacements and one overly broad theme.

records.judge_reason: Shell completion matches exactly. Async is a coherent split from the commands theme, and the prompts/stdin theme is a coherent subset of terminal I/O. records.judge_reason: Shell completion matches exactly. Parameter types and files match, but #1997 (test runner terminal width) is added there. Several of these are plausibly parsing-related (chain parsing, leftover args), but #680 and #1574 are context issues, so the theme gets large and somewhat mixed. records.judge_reason: Most labelled themes are recognisable in the report. Shell completion, prompts/terminal, parameter types and help formatting all match closely. records.judge_reason: Several report themes match the labelled ones: shell completion's core, the parser group, lazy files, help output, and the 9.0/internals group with embedding added. Meta issue with 15 comments that steers the parser redesign and many related parsing issues.

records.judge_reason: Most report themes match the labelled ones. Parser, File laziness, help output and the exceptions group line up closely. Merging #2781 and #2361 into an exceptions/colour/output-streams theme is a coherent alternative grouping. Dissolving the 9.0/internals bucket, and putting #2493 with context, are also defensible. Several issues are misplaced, though. #2853 (exception call-stack display) and #2402 (resolve_command fails if cmd is None) were put under shell completion, where they don't belong. #2706 (i18n) sits under invoking commands/context. #2783 (dynamic parameters on contexts) was put under parser. #2823 is missing entirely. These are a handful of errors, not mixed or vague themes.

top_issues.reason: Using = with long options breaks completion in both bash and zsh (zsh deletes the option); clear reproduction with expected-behaviour tables.
File lazy=True behaves differently on Windows than on Linux; someone worked on it at a sprint, so it may be close to fixed.
Lazy files can fail on named pipes depending on timing, which is hard to debug; the reporter offers concrete fixes and a workaround.
A full traceback is printed during Tab completion instead of just the error message; reported on Click 7.1.2 and questioned by a maintainer, so it needs checking on a current version.
Meta issue coordinating future parser changes (15 comments) that many parsing issues depend on.

records.judge_reason: Several report themes match the labelled ones: shell completion, lazy files, help output, and typing/i18n. There are real problems, though. The parser theme absorbs context and invoke issues (#2801, #2783, #2753), which merges the commands/context theme into parsing. Errors are merged with embedding and resolve_command. #2853 appears in two themes, and its placement under shell completion is wrong. #2419 sits under help/color rather than errors, which is defensible. #2823 is missing. Overall the result is mostly reasonable but has merged themes, a duplicate and misplacements.
